subject: Evaluation commit schedule, final pricing tiers & approval path
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightware.com>
Cc:  
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

Hi Liz —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP) that lines up the evaluation milestones with the commercial checkpoints we discussed. High level:

- Evaluation window: 6 weeks (pilot start 6/1)
- Pilot capacity: 2 dedicated nodes, capped at 1M inferred tokens/day
- Success criteria: latency <= 120ms p50, 3 core integrations validated (search, support chat, analytics)
- Commercial checkpoints:
  • Checkpoint 1 (Week 2): initial performance sign-off — no commercial change
  • Checkpoint 2 (Week 4): commit decision — preferred discount tier applies if commit >= $250k ARR
  • Checkpoint 3 (Week 6): full ramp readiness — final pricing and ramp schedule agreed

Attached: BrightWare_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with dates and responsibilities) and a quick sketch of price tiers in the cover sheet. The pricing approach in short: a baseline per-token rate, with step-down discounts tied to committed annual spend and a 3‑month ramp credit for onboarding.

Ask: can you confirm whether Procurement needs a single-line final quote or a signed MAP + SOW to kick off billing? If Procurement can accept a MAP + quote, we can prepare a one-page quote that mirrors the MAP and route DocuSign. If they require an SOW, notify me and I’ll loop in Legal/Deals to start redlines.

If you’re comfortable, we’ll aim to surface the internal approval request next week — I’ll need a quick green light from Marissa on discount banding and Naomi for any exception to standard ramp credits.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the pilot plan.

Best,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightWare_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightware.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightware.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@brightware.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

Thanks, Dev — appreciate the clear summary and the MAP. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement prefers a final one-page quote + MAP as the operational paperwork; SOW only if there are custom terms.
- Our VP of AI (cc’d Evan) wants quarterly ramp milestones for consumption visibility; he’s OK with a 6-week pilot but wants explicit ramp targets post-pilot.
- We can target a decision on commit (Checkpoint 2) by 6/12 but need any discount asks documented with expected ARR math.

Can Marissa and your finance team send the final quote showing the tiered discounts and the 3‑month ramp credit? Once Procurement has that we can run it through our internal approval.

—Liz
Head of Product Strategy
BrightWare
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-29T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

Liz — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Connor (Solutions). Connor: can you confirm the ramp target table and we'll bake it into the quote?

Marissa — draft quote attached (Final_Quote_BW-2026-042.pdf). Summary of the commercial proposal:

- Annual committed spend tiers:
  • Tier A: $250k+ ARR — 15% discount off list per-token rate + onboarding credit equal to 2 weeks of tokens
  • Tier B: $150–249k ARR — 10% discount + 1 week onboarding credit
  • Tier C: < $150k ARR — standard list with 30-day trial credits
- Ramp mechanics: 3-month ramp with target consumption at month-end: 25% / 60% / 100% of committed throughput
- Early termination: standard 60-day notice, pro-rated true-up for usage over committed amounts

Marissa, I put a recommended 15% discount at Tier A tied to a minimum 12‑month commit. Naomi, flagging you because a 15% discount is at the high-end of our playbook; if we need an exception larger than this we’ll need EMEA/Finance approval.

Next steps: Connor to confirm technical ramp table; Marissa to confirm GAAP-friendly billing language; Naomi to confirm discount line and exception path if needed. I’ve also included the HubSpot link to the deal.

Best,
Dev
[Attachment: Final_Quote_BW-2026-042.pdf (quote PDF)]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

Thanks — I reviewed the ramp table and adjusted the targets for safety margins based on expected initial latency tuning. Proposed ramp (post-pilot):

- Month 1 (onboarding): 20% of target throughput, 95th percentile headroom = 1.5x
- Month 2: 55% of target throughput, validate autoscaling triggers and KV cache warmup
- Month 3: 100% of target throughput, SLA monitoring and cost optimizations enabled

I added a short note in the MAP sheet about a fallback plan: if latency targets are missed at Checkpoint 2 we automatically extend the pilot for 2 weeks (no additional cost) to tune models and infra. That preserves the commercial cadence while protecting BrightWare.

Connor
Solutions Engineering, Redwood
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

All — I reviewed the quote. Given the size and likelihood of expansion, I recommend approving the Tier A 15% discount for a 12‑month commit. Rationale: expected ACV motion to $600–800k within 12 months once they integrate search + support chat.

Naomi — can you confirm a one-time onboarding credit (we documented 2 weeks in the quote) is within standard pricing allowances or if this needs a finance exception? If you approve, I’ll send the one-page quote to Procurement and fast-track the DocuSign envelope.

Also, we should include a single clause that allows a month-by-month ramp reconciliation for 90 days post-go-live to account for usage variability.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation commit schedule, pricing tiers & a quick approval ask

Marissa / Dev — approved. 15% Tier A discount + 2-week onboarding credit is acceptable for BW-2026-042. No additional finance escalation required. Please ensure billing language includes the ramp reconciliation and a clear definition of "committed throughput" (tokens/day) to avoid ambiguity.

Marissa, once you send the final one-page quote I’ll sign off and you can route the DocuSign link to BrightWare Procurement.

Naomi Feldman
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
